flashcard_questions.q: Which senior role plans and oversees a whole advertising campaign?
Which senior role leads the creative vision of a whole organisation?
Which senior role appoints heads of department and leads the final edit?
Which senior role coordinates schedules, budgets, crew, equipment and locations?
Which senior role oversees the editorial direction of published content?
What kind of decisions is a production manager responsible for?
flashcard_questions.a: Practical and logistical decisions, not creative ones.
A self-employed worker hired for specific projects rather than permanently employed by one company.

flashcard_questions.q: What income disadvantage does freelance work carry?
flashcard_questions.a: There is no guaranteed income or job security.

flashcard_questions.q: What financial security does employed work provide?
flashcard_questions.a: A regular salary and job security.

flashcard_questions.q: Why can a freelancer earn more than an employee?
How are roles allocated on a large production?
flashcard_questions.a: Each role is performed by a specialist.
Skills that can be used in any job, role or industry.

notes: 12 cards: 5 senior-role-to-description, 1 boundary card (production manager vs director), 4 freelance/employed cards, 2 concept cards. Career progression examples dropped as flavour; named progression routes left out so no awarding body is named.
